title: excluding a name the build does not list, or with another case, leaves the MCP part untouched and warns on stderr

stdout.regex: (?m)^model\ claude\-sonnet\-5\-5\ effort\ medium\ \|\ bypass\ \|\ MCP\ dbhub,openapi\ \|\ skill\ sprint\-testing$

stderr.equals: jitso: warning: --mcp-exclude "{{name}}" is not an MCP server of build sonnet-tester{{hint}}; nothing excluded

intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-26). An --mcp-exclude value that is not exactly an MCP server of the build changes nothing (the card still shows MCP dbhub,openapi) and prints one warning on stderr: `jitso: warning: --mcp-exclude "<name>" is not an MCP server of build <id>; nothing excluded`, with ` (did you mean "<server>"?)` before the semicolon when the name differs from a server only by case. The launch goes on, exit 0.
